name: Hiking
instructions: Wearing supportive footwear, walk on natural terrain such as trails, hills, or uneven ground, using trekking poles if desired for stability and to engage the upper body.
Take shorter, controlled steps on inclines and declines, bending your knees to absorb impact on the way down. Pace yourself for the total distance and elevation gain planned.
Hiking combines cardiovascular exercise with balance and stabilizer work from uneven footing. A 150 lb person can burn over 300 calories hiking for 30 minutes, more with a loaded pack.
